para.string: The instruction marks the start of an Intel TSX (RTM) suspend load address tracking region. If the instruction is used inside a transactional region, subsequent loads are not added to the read set of the transaction. If the instruc­tion is used inside a suspend load address tracking region it will cause transaction abort.
If the instruction is used outside of a transactional region it behaves like a NOP.
